seo.title: Borj Al-Kamra, Asilah | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: See Borj Al-Kamra in Asilah: the Portuguese square tower by the main medina gate, a compact landmark of the Atlantic art town.
seo.og_description: See Borj Al-Kamra in Asilah: the Portuguese square tower by the main medina gate, a compact landmark of the Atlantic art town.

name: Borj Al-Kamra
hero_subtitle: Una torre portuguesa cuadrada junto a la puerta principal de la medina de Asilah.

overview.title: Un hito portugués en la puerta
overview.p1: Borj Al-Kamra es la torre portuguesa junto a la entrada principal de la medina.
overview.p2: Fotográfiala con la puerta y continúa hacia la medina o las murallas.
overview.p3: Encaja de forma natural en un recorrido de 90 minutos.

1.title: Clear photos
1.desc: Soft light and fewer people at the gate.

2.title: Start of the walk
2.desc: Natural first stop when entering the medina.

3.title: Warm tones
3.desc: Stone picks up golden light before sunset.

food.title: Nearby food
food.p1: Cafés and restaurants around the main gate.
food.li4: Harbour fish a short walk away.
food.p2: The tower itself is a photo stop, not a dining spot.

1.title: Access
1.desc: At the main medina gate; impossible to miss on foot.

2.title: Photos
2.desc: Best from slightly back to include gate and tower.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Start here, walk the medina, finish at the ramparts.
